title: Regional Costing, Insights & Consulting Director EMEA (m/f/d)
description: A2MAC1 is a global leader in automotive benchmarking and competitive analysis, supporting manufacturers, suppliers, and mobility innovators worldwide. With a unique combination of data-driven insights, technology expertise, and industry knowledge, A2MAC1 empowers organizations to decode the future of mobility and accelerate transformation. We are looking for a Director Costing & Consulting EMEA (m/f/d) to lead our regional Costing organization and build consulting as a strategic growth capability. Based in Munich, you will hold executive accountability for the EMEA client-project portfolio from acquisition through post-delivery, including quality, delivery predictability, capacity and P&L. You will lead team leaders, customer program managers and cost engineers, advise senior clients and work closely with Sales and global functions to turn market needs into scalable, differentiated offerings. Your responsibilities Set the direction for the EMEA Costing organization and lead, mentor and develop team leaders, customer program managers and cost engineers. Define the regional capability strategy, building the leadership, technical and consulting skills required for current delivery and future growth. Own EMEA workforce planning, capacity allocation and portfolio priorities, resolving trade-offs and protecting customer and business commitments. Govern opportunity qualification across EMEA, ensuring executive sponsorship, disciplined risk assessment and profitable, executable commitments. Partner with Sales to shape complex opportunities, develop priority accounts and expand consulting-led propositions and strategic projects. Define and execute the EMEA consulting roadmap, create repeatable offerings and establish effective governance for solution shaping, staffing, delivery and knowledge reuse. Own regional delivery excellence across scope, milestones, budget and quality, and personally lead critical project and client escalations. Act as executive sponsor for complex consulting engagements and as a trusted advisor to senior clients on cost competitiveness, value engineering, benchmarking, sourcing and product optimization. Own the EMEA Costing P&L, resource forecasts, providing global leadership with transparent risks and corrective actions. Bring client and market feedback into global methodology, product and innovation development and share successful regional practices across the organization. Requirements Your profile A degree in engineering or a comparable technical discipline. At least 10 years of progressive experience in an automotive, cost-engineering, engineering-services or consulting environment. At least five years of successful leadership of a regional or multi-country function, including portfolio, P&L and executive client accountability and leadership of 10 or more people. A strong record of sponsoring and governing complex projects from solution shaping through delivery, including quality oversight, risk recovery and senior stakeholder management. Executive presence and credibility to advise and challenge senior clients, chair steering committees and navigate difficult commercial and delivery decisions. Broad understanding of automotive technologies and strong interest across powertrain, electronics, exterior, battery and interior domains. Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills, familiarity with project management tools & AI usage Professional proficiency in English. Benefits 50 EUR monthly Wellpass subsidy to support your health and wellbeing Subsidized meals in the canteen One paid day per year for volunteering in social or environmental projects December 24th and 31st off – so you can fully enjoy the holiday season Sabbatical options to take extended time off when you need it Flexible working hours with fair overtime compensation and time off in lieu Possibility to work from abroad for a limited number of days per year An international working environment with diverse projects and a strong team spirit Regular team events such as B2Run, Oktoberfest, Christmas parties and many more Free fruit, coffee, tea, water and snacks in the office Modern office at Laim station with good public transport access and parking spaces Interested? title: Senior Manager Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind? In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern : Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen. Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten : Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten. Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern : Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten. Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln : Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben. Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen : Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft. Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist. Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht. Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen. Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet. Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen , insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio). Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement. Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau . Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung : Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt. Berufliche Entwicklung: Nutze die Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen und Wachstum durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen. Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Flexible steuerfreie Benefits : Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann. Gleiche Chancen Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. Kontakt Wenn Du Interesse an dieser spannenden Herausforderung hast und Teil unseres wachsenden Teams werden möchtest, sende uns bitte Deinen Lebenslauf unter Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. description: Deine Karriere Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen. Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht. Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team. Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. title: Software Engineer, Platform - Lyon, France
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

Paper.io 2 is one of Voodoo's biggest games: 100M+ downloads and a top-ranked arcade title. It's simple, competitive and oddly satisfying, and it's played mostly by Gen Alpha (middle school / early high school).

Role

We're not looking for a community manager or a social media manager who posts three times a week and hopes for the best.


We're looking for a growth hacker who uses social media as their playground. You don't wait for the algorithm; you find ways to game it. You'd rather launch 100 accounts to see which 3 blow up than polish a single post for a week. You know the tricks, the loopholes and the formats nobody has tried yet, and you test them before everyone else does.


Your one mission: make Paper.io 2 massively viral on TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram, measured in views, engagement and virality.

  • Build an account machine: Launch and run a network of accounts: niche pages, personas, gameplay clips, languages, AI-produced content. Scale the ones that win and kill the rest fast.

  • Hack distribution: Seeding, comments, stitches and duets, fan accounts, cross-posting, and boosts on winning posts. Every post gets a plan to spread.

  • Activate creators and collabs: Find creators big and small, set up collabs, and turn players into content creators through challenges, UGC and in-game hooks.

  • Test everything, all the time: Hooks, formats, first frames, posting times, accounts. Read the data, double down on what works, cut the rest.

  • Report what you learn. Every week: what blew up, why, and what you're scaling next.

Most engineers spend their first years fixing tickets in someone else's system. You'd be building the core of ours.

Right now, when a buyer asks ChatGPT "what's the best tool for X", a handful of brands get recommended. Everyone else is invisible. And most companies have no idea which side they're on.

That's the problem GetMOW solves.

Why Cloud Studios exists

Cloud Studios is a Berlin app studio building a portfolio of premium, productised digital products. Small team, high standards, zero patience for boring. GetMOW is our current flagship: it shows B2B software companies how AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode actually see their brand, and what to change so they get recommended.

The logic is mappend out. Now it needs to be engineered properly.

The role

Your main job: turn our product logic into a real, running system. The engine behind GetMOW runs prompts across multiple AI platforms, collects and structures what comes back, analyses it, and turns it into insights a CMO can act on. We know exactly how it should work. We need someone who knows how to build it so it doesn't fall over the moment real customers are on it.

Here's the part most internships won't offer: this isn't a side feature. It's the heart of the product.

  • Architecting and building the backend system behind GetMOW's AI visibility analysis: orchestration across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI surfaces, data pipelines, scheduling, storage and processing
  • Designing AI workflows that are reliable, testable and cost-aware

  • Using AI tools (Claude Code or similar) to move fast, while owning every line that ships
  • Implementing new UI features from our product designer's designs and improving the existing frontend codebase

Requirements

  • Solid backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, async jobs, system design
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI workflows (API integrations, structured outputs, multi-step pipelines, evals, anything real)
  • Comfortable across our stack: Next.js + TypeScript + Supabase + Vercel, AI-native (Claude or similar)

  • You use AI to go faster, not to skip understanding
  • Strong English, written and spoken

Data Quality Executive

The role

An exciting opportunity has emerged to join the Data Quality Team as a Data Quality Executive at the UK’s number one property portal. Our partners are at the heart of everything we do, which means that we want to make things easy and right for them first time, every time.

As a member of Rightmove’s Data Quality Team you’ll play an important part in ensuring what’s displayed on Rightmove is accurate, fair and never misleading. Specifically, your role will focus on being the first point of contact for partners and consumers, content moderation, triaging inbound queries, and referring cases for assessment by the Data Quality Advisors when appropriate.

 

This role will include:

 

  • Monitor, moderate, and upload advert content to ensure alignment with legislation and Rightmove’s Technical and Text Content Guidelines.
  • Approve and verify reviews, ensuring authenticity and adherence to the DMCCA legislation.
  • Track review similarity and duplication, identifying patterns and potential misuse.

  • Act as first point of contact for sensitive or complex queries, resolving concerns with professionalism and empathy.
  • Support continuous improvement, identifying process enhancements within the Data Quality team.
  • Promote adoption of self-service tools and initiatives, encouraging partner engagement and providing clear guidance.

 

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes responsibility for their own workload, and for that of the team. You should be able to work under your own initiative and be self-motivating, determined to ensure the Data Quality inbox is always within our team targets.

description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 

Role Summary 

The Associate Director, Publishing provides strategic leadership for the PLOS journal portfolio, ensuring that portfolio priorities, publishing investments, and journal development strategies align with organizational goals and advance PLOS's mission. 

Reporting to the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations, the Associate Director leads and develops a team of Publishers responsible for the performance and strategic development of journals portfolios. The Associate Director serves as the primary steward of portfolio-wide publishing performance, translating organizational strategy into clear priorities and ensuring effective coordination across the organization. 

The Associate Director uses publishing data, financial information, market intelligence, and research community insight to guide strategic decisions, establish priorities, identify opportunities for growth and innovation, and manage risks. Working in partnership with the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations, the Associate Director ensures that journal-level strategies collectively support a sustainable PLOS portfolio with a strong value proposition. 

Supervisory Responsibilities 

  • Lead, develop, and support a team of senior publishing professionals responsible for journal and subject portfolio performance. 
  • Establish clear goals, priorities, and measures of accountability that align with organizational and portfolio strategy. 
  • Provide coaching, professional development, succession planning, and performance management for direct reports. 
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
  • Work with Publishers to ensure effective leadership and development of Journal Development Managers and other publishing staff. 

Responsibilities 

Portfolio Strategy and Performance 

  • Develop and implement a portfolio-wide publishing strategy aligned with PLOS's mission and organizational objectives. 
  • Ensure that journal and subject portfolio strategies collectively support a clear and differentiated value proposition for the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Lead regular portfolio reviews and develop recommendations regarding journal positioning, growth opportunities, performance, and future direction. 
  • Balance the needs of individual journals and research communities with broader portfolio and organizational objectives. 
  • Support Publishers in identifying and responding to changes in research communities, funding policies, scholarly communication, and the publishing market.
  • Develop consistent approaches and decision-making frameworks for evaluating proposals, opportunities, and performance across the portfolio. 
  • Guide the evaluation and development of new journals, products, services, publishing models in line with PLOS’s strategic direction.  

Strategic and Business Leadership 

  • Translate organizational strategy into clear portfolio priorities, objectives, and plans for the publishing team. 
  • Oversee publishing budgets and forecasts in partnership with the Director and Publishers, ensuring responsible decision-making and effective resource allocation. 
  • Act as a thought partner to, and deputize for, the Director, Publishing & Publishing Operations when appropriate. 
  • In close collaboration with colleagues in Editorial, Sales and Global Publishing Development, support publishers in developing impactful relationships with Editors-in-Chief, Editorial Board members, researchers, institutions, societies, and partner organizations. 
  • Build productive partnerships across Editorial, Publishing Operations, Sales & Global Publishing Development, Product, Technology, Marketing, Finance, Research Integrity, and other organizational teams. 
  • Work with Editorial and Publishing Operations leaders to ensure that journal strategies are supported by effective policies, processes, services, and quality standards. 
  • Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen journal positioning, audience engagement, portfolio visibility, and demand generation. 

Leadership and Culture

  • Model the culture and behaviors PLOS is seeking to build, actively driving the culture change the organization needs through this transformation.
  • Serve as a collaborative leader across PLOS, fostering strong cross-functional partnerships and organizational alignment that enable shared organizational priorities to be delivered successfully.
  • Lead change effectively by ensuring a clear strategic rationale, defined outcomes, appropriate measures of success, realistic resource requirements and clear accountability and decision-making.

Qualifications & Skills 

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Business problem solver – operates with curiosity to get to the root of the business problem to ensure the ultimate solution is grounded in PLOS’s strategy and mission.
  • Substantial experience launching Open Access journals from proposal to publication.
  • Strong commercial and financial skills, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, business planning and P&L ownership.
  • Substantial experience in STM publishing with progressively increased responsibility.
  • Experience managing senior publishing professionals, or comparable portfolio leaders. 
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic plans that deliver measurable business and operational outcomes.
  • Strong track record of leading and developing high-performing, geographically distributed teams.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills across cultures, disciplines, and organizational functions.
  • Dedication to open access and transforming scholarly communication, with a genuine interest in engaging productively with the scientific community.

Preferred 

  • Experience leading high-volume journal portfolios and/or megajournals.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer. 
  • Some national and international travel may be required. 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones may be required.

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (US): $145,000- $157,000 or (UK) £90,000- £104,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)

UK:

  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Research Associate / Associate Scientist to join our Molecular Biology platform within the High Throughput Laboratory.

Reporting to the Scientific Manager, this role will be responsible for delivering high-quality molecular biology workflows that underpin Quotient's somatic genomics platform. Working closely with Histology, Flow Cytometry, Assay Development, Automation and Data Science, you will support the processing of human tissue-derived samples from nucleic acid extraction through to sequencing-ready libraries.

The successful candidate will combine excellent technical expertise with a passion for continuous improvement, working collaboratively across scientific teams to optimise workflows, troubleshoot technical challenges and help implement new technologies into routine laboratory operations.

This role is ideally suited to someone who enjoys operating in a fast-paced biotechnology environment, is passionate about molecular biology, and is excited by the opportunity to contribute to a growing high-throughput genomics platform.

Responsibilities: 

  • Execute high-quality molecular biology workflows including DNA and RNA extraction from human tissues and isolated cells/nuclei.
  • Perform nucleic acid quantification, quality assessment and fragmentation to support downstream sequencing applications.
  • Prepare high-quality NGS libraries using a variety of library preparation methodologies.
  • Support implementation, optimisation and routine operation of automated molecular biology workflows.
  • Troubleshoot molecular biology workflows, identifying opportunities to improve quality, reproducibility and throughput.
  • Work closely with Histology and Flow Cytometry teams to ensure seamless progression of samples through the High Throughput Laboratory.
  • Support implementation of new technologies and molecular biology methods developed by Assay Development into routine laboratory operations.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records using Benchling and associated laboratory information systems.
  • Ensure compliance with laboratory quality systems, the Human Tissue Act, COSHH and all relevant laboratory procedures.
  • Contribute to SOP development, protocol optimisation and continuous improvement initiatives across the Molecular Biology platform.
  • Support training and mentoring of junior Research Associates where appropriate.

Qualifications:

Essential

  • BSc, MSc or equivalent experience in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry or a related life science discipline.
  • Significant hands-on experience working within a molecular biology laboratory (typically 3–5+ years in industry or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated experience extracting high-quality DNA and RNA from a variety of biological sample types.
  • Hands-on experience performing nucleic acid fragmentation and quality assessment.
  • Experience preparing Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) libraries.
  • Experience operating within a high-throughput laboratory environment.
  • Experience using laboratory automation or supporting automated molecular biology workflows.
  • Excellent laboratory organisation, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working under the Human Tissue Act and associated quality systems.
  • Experience using ELN/LIMS platforms (Benchling preferred).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary scientific teams.

Desirable

  • Experience with NanoSeq or similar ultra-sensitive sequencing assays.
  • Knowledge of somatic genomics, mutation detection and cancer genomics workflows.
  • Experience working with Fixed and fresh frozen tissue.
  • Experience preparing sequencing libraries for low-input or challenging biological samples.
  • Experience supporting implementation of automated liquid handling systems.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Assay Development and Automation teams.
  • Experience within a rapidly growing biotechnology organisation.
  • Knowledge of laboratory process optimisation and Operational Excellence methodologies.

Values and Behaviors:

  • Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence
  • Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source
  • Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions
  • Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success
  • Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes

About Quotient:

Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs. 

The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS).

Quotient Therapeutics and Flagship Pioneering are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Billing Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)


Our Mission For You
Own the invoicing engine of a hyper-growth energy-tech company. Your work directly protects our cash flow and keeps our growth engine running. Invoicing directly affects our cash flow in the millions. This role is a lever, not a cost center.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth company with strong team growth, rising invoice volumes, and increasing complexity per invoice. Individual contracts, PPAs, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes: every customer segment is a small puzzle. Today, that puzzle is solved mostly manually, and it needs to move to the next level.

You'll build order out of that complexity. You'll jump into individual invoices when it matters. At the same time, you'll design the process that makes those individual jumps unnecessary. You'll be part of our Billing Tool Rollout and help prepare invoicing for our ERP migration. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own the operation, not just manage it.


What You'll Own

Own Invoicing End to End

  • Own daily invoicing processes to trawa customers: quality, completeness, timing

  • Reduce and eliminate our current ticket backlog through prioritization, root-cause analysis, and systematic execution

  • Ensure complex billing logic (PPA, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes) is correctly reflected in every invoice

  • Own the invoicing KPIs: on-time rate, error rate, ticket aging, time-to-invoice

Build Scalable Processes

  • Be part of designing and rolling out a scalable invoicing architecture, from today's manual setup to a standardized and automated solution

  • Automate recurring process steps

  • Document everything: reproducible, hand-off-ready, audit-ready

Stakeholder & Customer Communication

  • Direct customer communication on invoicing questions, in writing (German and English)

  • Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to secure upstream data quality (contracts, prices, delivery points)

  • Partner closely with our Tech/Data team, where consumption data, time series, and energy accruals are your input

  • Establish escalation paths and priority logic with Sales and CS, so edge cases don't block the standard process

Data Quality & Handover to Accounting

  • Ensure invoicing data flows cleanly into accounting, as the interface to our accounting team

  • Contribute to month-end close: clean invoicing cut-off, documented open items, accruals-relevant data ready on time

  • Audit-readiness from an invoicing perspective: process documentation, invoice-level traceability, controls


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years in Billing, Order-to-Cash, Finance Operations, or similar operational Finance roles

  • Scale-up experience, with at least one station at a fast-growing company. You've worked without a clean ERP, with ambiguous processes, in a team being built as it runs

  • B2B billing with complex pricing models, not SaaS flat-rate. You've handled individual contracts, volume-based logic, or formula-driven pricing

  • Proven high-output track record. You've personally delivered and you can point to a moment where you built or saved a critical process

  • Systems thinker with a detail obsession. You see the pattern behind ticket or invoice corrections

  • Excel/ Sheets power user. You build models others can't unpack, and you document them so they can

  • Strong stakeholder management

  • Ownership mindset. You take things on without asking whether it's "in your role"

  • Business fluent in English and German (written); speaking is a big plus

Nice-to-haves

  • Energy or utility experience

  • Hands-on experience with a Billing Tool rollout or ERP implementation

  • SQL, Python basics, or hands-on experience with AI tools (Claude, Langdock, n8n)

Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Land & Understand

  • Understand our business model, the German energy market basics, and our billing complexity. Understand what drives our corrections rate. Build relationships with the most important stakeholders.

Month 2: Stabilize

  • Keep invoicing running stably while spotting optimization opportunities. Define clear ticket priorities and escalation paths with Sales and CS. Ship first quick wins in automation and process design. Define and start tracking your KPIs: error rate, ticket aging.

Month 3: Build

  • Deliver a target process architecture for improvements to our current invoicing processes. Actively and proactively reduce time-to-invoice and corrections rates. Present your automation and process roadmap to the finance leadership team.

Why trawa?

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the invoicing function that unlocks trawa's growth

  • Direct collaboration in a complex stakeholder set-up, with direct contact to our finance leadership team

  • A uniquely complex problem space at the intersection of energy, tech, and finance

  • An AI-first Finance team that embraces new tools and ways of working

  • Accelerated career growth in a scaling environment with massive scope

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant office culture


Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets.

  • Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises.

  • Champion Technical Solutions: Direct complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles by clearly communicating the strategic, financial, and technical ROI of RobCo's modular robotics and physical AI solutions.

  • Scale Enterprise Footprint: Identify and unlock new market verticals and geographic opportunities across the DACH region to continually expand the sales pipeline.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering and Product teams to align client requirements with product capabilities and deliver seamless rollouts.

  • Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene, actionable sales reporting, and highly accurate quarterly/annual revenue forecasts in Salesforce.

  • Represent the Brand: Position RobCo as the premier AI-driven automation provider through representation at key industry events, panel discussions, and executive roundtables.

  • Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience.

  • Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.

  • Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles.

  • Deep understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50-75% within Germany for client meetings, trade shows, onsite evaluations, and international team offsites.

  • Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high drive for results, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

Unser neues Projekt Piqit ist ein KI-gestützter Shopping-Assistant, der die Art und Weise verändert, wie Menschen online Produkte finden und kaufen. Piqit berät den Nutzer interaktiv und findet passende Produkte aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten , vergleicht Preise über zahlreiche Shops hinweg und führt direkt zum passenden Anbieter – von Wein und Werkzeug über Elektronik und Haushaltsgeräte bis hin zu Beauty, Schmuck und Möbeln. Dafür suchen wir dich als Product Manager AI Search (m/w/d) . Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung. Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt. Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat. Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein. Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt. Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung. Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte. Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an. Deine Stärken Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität zeichnet dich aus – du willst Dinge selbst bauen und live sehen, statt sie zu delegieren und nachzuhalten Mit Sprachmodellen hast du über gelegentliches Prompting hinaus praktisch gearbeitet: Du hast Prompts systematisch verbessert, Ergebnisse verglichen und weißt, wo diese Systeme kippen – idealerweise mit Lösungen wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Gemini Durch dein Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse erkennst du, was hinter einer Anfrage steckt und wann eine Antwort nur oberflächlich passt Du überzeugst durch eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und hast Lust, deine Ideen aktiv im Team einzubringen Technisch bist du anschlussfähig: Du liest eine API-Antwort, verstehst eine Datenstruktur und hast keine Scheu vor SQL – programmieren musst du nicht, selbst anpacken schon Erfahrung mit Retrieval, Ranking oder semantischer Suche sowie mit dem Aufbau von Evals und Testsets ist wünschenswert Kenntnisse in Produktdaten, Feeds, Taxonomien und Attributsystemen sind von Vorteil, ebenso Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make oder Python sowie mit MCP- und Agenten-Anbindungen Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit Unser Angebot Dein Tagesablauf gehört dir Arbeite dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Ob Früh- oder Spätaufsteher: Bei uns passt du deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel an – in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team. Zeitweise Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland? Kein Problem. Dein Laptop ist dein Arbeitsplatz. Unsere Kultur ist einmalig Hier sitzen alle auf derselben Couch – unabhängig von Titel oder Rolle. Teamspirit leben wir digital und vor Ort, z. B. bei Gaming Nights, Workouts, Filmabenden oder Teamevents. Viermal im Jahr treffen wir uns zur Company Week Gemeinsam im Büro arbeiten, Projekte pushen, Pizzabende genießen und mit einer Party abschließen. Mitten in Hamburg Zentral gelegen zwischen Hauptbahnhof, Mönckebergstraße und Binnenalster – perfekt für Lunch-Dates, Pausen an der Alster oder einen Feierabendbummel. raw.title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
raw.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset
  • A workplace in a central location in Saarbrücken with good transport links
  • An open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexitime scheme with core working hours
  • Company sports programme (Hansefit)
  • Subsidised parking in the city centre or a travel allowance for public transport
  • JobRad

Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Das wäre ein Plus: Erfahrung in der Erwachsenenbildung oder beruflichen Weiterbildung. AEVO-Schein (AdA), Train the Trainer oder eine vergleichbare berufspädagogische Qualifikation. At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Global technology and creative network that bridges the gap between engineering and design to drive business transformation for leading enterprise brands. They partner with executive leadership to redefine possibilities, create lasting impact, and implement the necessary technologies to power the entire customer journey.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the core of enterprise transformation engagements, directly embedding with client teams to redesign workflows, establish operating models, and drive technology adoption. This is a highly hands-on, consultative role where you will conduct organizational diagnostics and rapidly build functional, AI-powered proofs of concept to demonstrate real-world value. The ideal candidate is a proactive diagnostician and builder who blends management consulting expertise with the technical capability to ship working prototypes autonomously, ultimately accelerating business adoption and delivering measurable ROI.

Responsibilities

  • Map current-state workflows end-to-end to diagnose root causes of operational friction, including handoff failures, governance gaps, and tooling mismatches.

  • Redesign target-state operations for leaner workflows, clearer decision rights, and effective human-agent collaboration to accelerate throughput using AI.

  • Design comprehensive operating models, including organizational structure, roles, governance, cross-functional interaction models, and value realization.

  • Establish performance baselines and build measurement frameworks that track improvement continuously throughout the engagement.

  • Identify value gaps in stalled implementations, diagnosing where technology deployment has outpaced business adoption to restore the path to ROI.

  • Build working, AI-powered prototypes directly utilizing LLM APIs, platform-native features, and low-code/no-code environments to create functional solutions.

  • Utilize working demos and prototypes as the primary tool for stakeholder alignment directly within the client's actual processes.

  • Evaluate where AI practically enhances a workflow versus where it serves as a distraction, advising clients with realistic, grounded expectations.

  • Support the rollout of new tools and workflows, ensuring adoption is rooted in process design and change management.

  • Design enablement materials that ensure new technology implementations effectively connect to and support the intended operating model.

  • Support complex engagement scoping and conduct diagnostic assessments for value capture, implementation readiness, and adoption strategy.

  • Contribute reusable frameworks and tools that continuously improve practice qualification and scoping.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in management consulting or equivalent roles within enterprise technology, SaaS, or professional services.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least two of the following areas: organizational design, operating model transformation, change management, technology enablement, process engineering, or go-to-market execution.

  • Proven track record of building structured, evidence-based arguments to effectively influence and align senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience building functional AI-powered workflows, automations, and prototypes, with the ability to ship working solutions rather than just designing them.

  • Ability to rapidly scope and build a working proof of concept within the constraints of a client engagement to move skeptical stakeholders.

  • Comfort and capability working autonomously without a dedicated engineering team, knowing exactly when to build solutions independently and when to pull in additional resources.

  • Strong diagnostic mindset with a dedication to understanding root causes and broken processes before jumping to solutions.

  • Deep accountability to actual outcomes and measurable impact rather than just static deliverables.

  • Bias toward early proof, preferring to build working prototypes over producing standard roadmaps.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a forward-deployed capacity, integrating deeply alongside client engineers, product leads, and operators.

  • Experience in large-scale organizational assessments, process redesigns, or large-scale technology rollouts is highly preferred.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

raw.jobDescription:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A global digital transformation organization that helps leading enterprises reimagine how they create, manage, and deliver customer experiences by combining technology, creativity, AI, and engineering. Through multidisciplinary teams and hands-on execution, we partner with organizations to modernize workflows, scale content operations, accelerate innovation, and build solutions that drive measurable business impact.

Job Summary

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the core of content and creative transformation engagements.

In this role, you will map existing creative workflows, redesign them, and build AI-powered pipelines that demonstrate a new operating model inside real production environments.

Building is not a differentiator in this role - it is the job. The ideal candidate comes from creative technology, production engineering, content operations, or applied AI within creative environments. You operate inside workflows, not above them.

Depending on the engagement, you may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded directly within client teams and working alongside creative directors, producers, marketing technology leads, content operations teams, and engineers to redesign and ship workflows in real time.

This is not a separate program or specialization. It is an expected mode of working, requiring adaptability, hands-on execution, and close collaboration with stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Workflow Mapping & Redesign

  • Map creative workflows end-to-end, including briefing, concepting, production, review, localization, activation, and measurement.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation.

  • Diagnose root causes of workflow friction, including approval delays, handoff failures, tooling gaps, and governance challenges.

  • Design future-state workflows that effectively balance AI automation and human oversight.

AI Pipeline Development

This is the core responsibility of the role.

  • Configure and implement creative AI platforms and tools against real production requirements.

  • Integrate AI-powered workflows into existing ecosystems, including DAMs, CMS platforms, marketing technology stacks, and project management systems.

  • Build prompt architectures, agent workflows, automation layers, and quality control mechanisms that can operate reliably at production scale.

  • Develop working proofs of concept and production-ready solutions that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Rapidly iterate and deploy solutions within the constraints of active client engagements.

Governance & Adoption

  • Establish governance frameworks covering brand safety, content rights management, model selection, approval workflows, compliance, and auditability.

  • Train and enable teams to successfully adopt new workflows and technologies.

  • Define and track success metrics, including throughput, cycle time, cost-per-asset, quality consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term sustainability beyond the initial engagement.

Engagement Support & Practice Development

  • Contribute to project scoping and solution design across content operations, creative production, AI transformation, and marketing technology initiatives.

  • Develop reusable accelerators, templates, tooling configurations, and best practices.

  • Help evolve internal methodologies and delivery frameworks for future engagements.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in creative technology, content operations, production engineering, marketing technology, automation, or applied AI.

  • Demonstrated track record of shipping production-ready solutions with measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience working across both creative and technical stakeholder groups.

  • Proven ability to translate operational challenges into scalable workflow solutions.

Builder Capability (Required)

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying creative, content, or marketing workflow solutions.

  • Experience configuring and implementing creative AI tools and automation platforms in real-world environments.

  • Working knowledge of DAM systems, CMS platforms, content APIs, project management tools, and orchestration frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and workflow automation.

  • Ability to independently create and deploy proofs of concept that drive stakeholder alignment and adoption.

Creative Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of creative production processes, content supply chains, and asset lifecycle management.

  • Familiarity with enterprise creative ecosystems, including tools such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Workfront, Adobe Firefly, Figma, and related platforms.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with creative directors, producers, brand operations teams, content strategists, and marketing technology stakeholders.

Mindset

  • Strong bias toward execution and delivery.

  • Diagnostic and systems-thinking approach to problem solving.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.

  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.

  • Focused on practical solutions that create measurable impact.

  • Most effective working directly within operational environments rather than from a purely advisory position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise content supply chain transformation initiatives.

  • Familiarity with creative AI platforms, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

  • Exposure to Adobe ecosystem products, including Firefly Services, GenStudio, AEM, and Workfront.

  • Experience embedding with client teams in consulting, agency, or enterprise transformation environments.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrated Workflows
description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through. That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do. Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on. This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it. Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build and evolve two-way sync with the systems of record where customer work lives (Jira, Linear, Asana, and others), so decisions made on the canvas become tracked work and stay in raw.jobExcerpt: ABOUT THE TEAM The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces…
raw.jobDescription:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through.

That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do.

Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on.

This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and evolve two-way sync with the systems of record where customer work lives (Jira, Linear, Asana, and others), so decisions made on the canvas become tracked work and stay in sync as that work changes

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations across the Microsoft ecosystem (Teams, Outlook, Office), video conferencing platforms, and third-party notification targets such as Slack and Teams

  • Build and evolve the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns other Mural teams use to ship their own connected experiences

  • Own the content pathways in and out of Mural, including the import and image panels, third-party image APIs such as Unsplash, copy/paste to and from outside Mural, file upload handling, iFrame embedding, self-serve PDF to Mural conversion, and Mural exports and downloads

  • Partner across teams on shared boundaries and hold up your side of those contracts, including render for exports, the notification engine, and company-level migration

  • Maintain and support our public API for existing third-party developers, with the backwards-compatibility discipline a published interface demands

  • Lead projects end to end, from research, design, and POC through execution, release, and iteration

  • Build flexible and maintainable solutions while being accountable for quality, performance, reliability, and the security posture of everything crossing our system boundary

  • Use AI tools as part of your fundamental workflows

  • Design, plan, and implement automated testing and documentation strategies, including for the failure modes that only show up when someone else's API misbehaves

  • Elevate the team's skills and knowledge by participating in technical designs and talks, and by reviewing and helping improve your and your colleagues' code

  • Contribute to constantly improving the team's processes and best practices

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, or other modern frameworks

  • Hands-on experience integrating with third-party APIs and platforms: OAuth and token lifecycle management, webhooks, rate limiting and backoff, pagination, versioning, and graceful degradation when an upstream service fails

  • 5+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

  • Strong track record of designing and delivering scalable, high-performance systems

  • An outcome-oriented and highly-experimental interest in AI-driven development practices

  • Proven experience planning technical projects and delivering new systems and features iteratively, with a focus on delivering value to customers quickly

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, able to lead technical discussions and navigate trade-offs effectively

  • Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments or startups is a plus

  • Experience building against Microsoft Teams or Office add-in SDKs, or shipping through a partner marketplace or app review process

  • Experience designing and maintaining a public developer API

  • Experience with Python

  • Familiarity with secure file handling at scale, including permissions checks, malware scanning, and content validation on upload

  • Experience with content migration or format conversion between products, and the fidelity problems that come with it

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
