Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

    • Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel.

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie)

  • Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet

  • Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un rôle central et à forte visibilité, au contact de l’ensemble des collaborateurs et en lien direct avec la Direction,

  • Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel,

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People.

title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . Ce que tu feras chez nous Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation . Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à : Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne. Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume. Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle. À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours : Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire. Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients. Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique. Nous attendons également : Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle . Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI. Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré. Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering . Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables. Nice-to-have Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD. Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé. Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé. Ta manière de travailler Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions. Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place. Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact. Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes. Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté. Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique. Process de recrutement Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte. Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance. Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses. Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs. title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 🦾 Our Offer Operations team Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast. Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work. 🎯 What you will do As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun , our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects. Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering. Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go. Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it. Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most. Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment. AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest. Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again. Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering. raw.title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
raw.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

  • Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

title: Business Development Representative Intern
description: Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk. Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust. As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions. As Akur8 continues to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Representative Intern to support our Sales team in identifying relevant prospects and creating new conversations with insurance professionals. You will join an international Sales team focused on growing Akur8’s client base through new business, account development, and long-term relationships. You will work closely with Sales Directors, Sales Executives Marketing, Sales Operations, and our Actuarial experts. This internship will give you practical experience in B2B SaaS sales, prospecting, and the insurance technology market. Your mission will include, but not be limited to, the following: PROSPECT RESEARCH • Identify insurance companies, reinsurers, brokers, and other relevant organisations that may benefit from Akur8’s solutions. • Research target accounts, their business priorities, and the people involved in pricing, reserving, actuarial, data, and innovation projects. • Build and maintain clear account lists to support focused outreach. OUTBOUND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT • Write personalised email and LinkedIn messages that speak to each prospect’s role and business context. • Support outbound calling and follow-up campaigns with guidance from experienced sales colleagues. • Test different messages, channels, and approaches, then share what you learn with the team. LEAD QUALIFICATION AND HANDOFF • Engage with prospects to understand their current processes, challenges, priorities, and potential timelines. • Qualify early conversations against agreed criteria and identify relevant next steps. • Schedule meetings for Account Executives and prepare clear handover notes so that each conversation starts with useful context. SALES AND MARKETING COLLABORATION • Work with Marketing on campaigns, webinars, events, and content aimed at insurance professionals. • Share feedback from prospects to help improve messaging and campaign targeting. • Support the Sales team with account mapping, event preparation, and follow-up activities. • Support the preparation of client-facing slides and materials, review documents created by the team, and adapt content to address specific client needs. CRM AND REPORTING • Keep prospect and activity information accurate in the CRM. • Track outreach, responses, meetings, and follow-up actions. • Prepare simple activity reports and contribute ideas to improve the team’s day-to-day sales process. You will be based in Paris and will work primarily from our office. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, events, or conferences. We are looking for someone who is curious about business, comfortable speaking with new people, and ready to learn through practice. EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE • You are currently enrolled in a Business School, university, or equivalent programme and are looking for a full-time 6-month internship, with a starting date between October and December. • You are interested in B2B sales, technology, insurance, or a role that combines business conversations with analytical thinking. • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you are comfortable adapting your message to different audiences. • You are organized, persistent, and able to manage several follow-up tasks without losing track of details. • You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and respond well to feedback. • You enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions. • You have strong spoken and written English & French. Additional language is a bonus. BONUS SKILLS / EXPERIENCE • A first experience in sales, business development, customer service, or another role involving outreach. • Familiarity with a CRM, sales engagement platform, LinkedIn, or other tools used to research and contact prospects. • Previous experience in an international company, student association, start-up, or technology environment. • An interest in the insurance industry and in the way data can support better business decisions. As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion. We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings. In addition to this, we will provide you with: Monthly compensation Top-notch laptops & equipments Lunch vouchers As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially. Location: Remote, US-based

Type: Full-Time, Employee

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

raw.jobDescription:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Remote Location:

Austin, TX; or Washington, DC

Position Summary

HackerOne is redefining how the world’s leading organizations manage cyber risk — and AI is at the center of that transformation. As Senior Manager, AI Engineering, you will own two of the most strategically important product surfaces in our platform:

  • AI-Native Intelligence Dashboard — Transform our executive and analytical dashboard into an AI-first experience that helps customers derive maximum value from their HackerOne engagement. Think proactive risk insights, natural language querying, automated remediation prioritization, and measurable reduction in Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR).

  • Payments & Monetization — Lead the team responsible for researcher payments and consumption-based billing, ensuring security researchers are paid reliably and HackerOne’s contract monetization engine runs cleanly at scale.

You will lead the team of senior engineers, set technical direction, and ship AI-powered capabilities that customers can see, feel, and measure. This is a high-autonomy role with real product ownership and direct customer impact.

Reflecting our Flexible Work philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Washington DC, Boston, or Austin, with in-office presence typically on Thursdays.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of the listed locations above. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

What You Will Do

Success in this role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

  • Multiply Your Impact by leading, mentoring, and developing Engineering Managers and senior engineers, building scalable systems and practices that allow teams to deliver AI-powered solutions consistently and independently

  • Drive an AI First approach to engineering by embedding AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, and responsible AI practices into how teams design, build, and operate products

  • Practice Change Agility by guiding teams through evolving AI technologies, shifting priorities, and emerging security threats while maintaining clarity, momentum, and team health

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to complex AI and product challenges, breaking problems down to fundamentals and designing durable, scalable solutions rather than short-term workarounds

  • Leverage Data-Driven Decision Making to assess system performance, model quality, delivery outcomes, and operational health, using evidence to inform priorities and improvements

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, Security Research, and other Engineering leaders to align AI engineering efforts with company strategy and customer needs

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience managing product engineering teams, including teams delivering AI-powered or data-intensive systems

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams with complex dependencies across engineering, product, and non-technical partners

  • Experience developing and mentoring Engineering Managers

  • Strong technical foundation in modern software systems that support AI-enabled products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling applied AI systems in production environments

  • Familiarity with human-in-the-loop, agentic, or automation-driven workflows

title: Security Engineer Intern
description: About the role Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code. As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship. What you will do Detection and response Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed. Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals. Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark. Security audits Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers. Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets. Projects you will own Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform. Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations). Fraud Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier. raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge - close to your users. They power use cases such as webhook receivers, AI inferences, OG image generation and real-time bots (Slack, Discord, etc). Built on top of Supabase Edge Runtime: an open-source, Deno-based runtime written in Rust that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

We want developers to be able to build truly global applications by distributing both compute and data globally. Infrastructure concerns like regions, cold starts, CPU and memory provisioning should fade into the background so developers can focus on iterating on business logic.

We are looking for experienced and passionate engineers to help us go further in this vision.

What You’ll Own

  • Evolving Supabase Edge Runtime - an Open-sourced Rust-based host that runs the Deno isolate, manages the main/user runtime split, and enforces per-request memory and CPU limits.

  • Implementing monitoring, alerting, and OpenTelemetry tracing across the runtime, then using that visibility to drive optimizations that improve latency and reliability of the service.

  • Working closely with the Deno and other open-source teams, contributing to upstream and relaying our users' requirements.

  • Participating in an on-call rotation to keep Edge Functions healthy in production.

  • Help manage and improve features like scheduled functions, background tasks, WebSockets streaming, ephemeral file storage, and custom routing.

  • Integrating functions more tightly with the rest of the Supabase stack - Auth, Postgres, Storage, and Realtime.

  • Expanding functions to support more use cases (AI inference, MCP servers, hosting simple websites, URL shorteners).

  • Improving the DX of developing and debugging functions locally through the Supabase CLI, including DevTools integration, logging, and production parity.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with strong fluency in Rust and TypeScript.

  • Experience with V8 Isolates, Deno and the JavaScript runtimes in general.

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale - Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare Workers, Redis, or comparable systems.

  • A strong vision for how compute and data can be pushed to the edge.

  • Bonus: experience building developer-facing CLIs or front-end tooling that sits on top of an infrastructure product.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

Company Description

ecosio is a fast-growing, innovative service company and a leading provider of B2B integration, specialising in electronic data interchange (EDI), Web EDI and e-invoicing. ecosio is part of Vertex, Inc., a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions listed on Nasdaq (VERX).

Our brand slogan is Connections That Work as we believe strong connections are central to successful business relationships - both external and internal. At ecosio, we hire individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We are technology lovers, set the highest standards for our solutions, and put innovative ideas first.

Job Description

You'll connect with the role if you enjoy...

  • optimising e-invoicing and global supply chains by planning, coordinating and technically implementing e-invoicing and EDI projects on our cloud platform
  • communicating worldwide with our partner companies, customers and their suppliers
  • acting as the interface between our customers, their ERP System and our SaaS platform
  • taking on new customers (after handover from Sales) and independently progressing your integration projects
  • appearing as a sparring partner for our customers and solving their technical issues
  • performing proactively to ensure each project’s success
  • coordinating mappings for e-invoicing and EDI integration with the document engineering team for your integration projects
  • encouraging the evaluation and implementation of new tools and processes for the project and managing the process

Qualifications

To connect with ecosio it is important to have…

  • several years of work experience in e-invoicing and/or EDI
  • experience with the integration of ERP import and export interfaces based on XML, CSV and IDocs
  • experience with EDI onboardings, EDI service providers and Value Added Networks (VANs)
  • experience with national e-invoicing mandates around the globe
  • in-depth knowledge of typical EDI and integration formats like XML, EDIFACT, ANSI X12, and VDA as well as EDI protocols like AS2, OFTP2 or PEPPOL
  • excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage (French, German, Italian, Chinese, etc)
  • know-how in project management, supply chain management and/or logistics
  • strong organisational skills and enjoy working independently

Additional Information

By connecting with us you will experience...

  • Our remote-first culture lets you work remotely from one of our designated countries
  • Flexible working hours to suit your schedule and priorities
  • Annual personal development budget to invest in conferences, courses, or career coaching
  • Home office allowance to create a workspace that fits your needs
  • Regular events and trips to connect, celebrate, and have fun with the team
  • Workations of up to 90 days per year within the EU, combining travel and productivity
  • Wellbeing support, including mental health resources and employee assistance programs
  • Additional country-specific benefits based on your location

raw.jobDescription:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

  • Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

  • Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

  • Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

  • Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

  • Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

  • Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

  • Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring:

  • Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

  • AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

  • Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

  • Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

  • Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

  • A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

  • Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

  • Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

  • On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

You'll ship features end-to-end that patients and clinicians depend on every day — and you'll be expected to care about why you're building something, not just how. Description

Limbic's vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere. The way we do that is by deploying AI responsibly, using it to augment clinical care and reduce barriers to accessing therapy at scale. Limbic is already used extensively in Talking Therapies in the UK, and now expanding operations in the US market.

Every day, thousands of patients already interact with Limbic, making therapy more accessible. Limbic goes beyond replacing existing processes with AI and helps people recover from their mental health challenges who otherwise would not have.

We're seeking a Senior Full-stack Engineer who's motivated by seeing their work change outcomes for real people. You'll ship features end-to-end that patients and clinicians depend on every day — and you'll be expected to care about why you're building something, not just how. If you've ever pushed back on a ticket because you didn't think it served users, or shipped something and then chased down the data to see if it actually worked, this is your kind of team.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end, including:

    • Implementing TypeScript/Node.js backend services compliant with data residency and regulatory standards

    • Building React user interfaces for both patient-facing and clinician-facing products

    • Modeling and handling application data (MongoDB, PostgreSQL) using regulatory compliance best practices

    • Integrating features with ML/AI services and safety guardrails

  • Shape what gets built, not just how — contribute to product decisions, challenge requirements when they don't serve users, and measure the impact of what you ship

  • Treat security, data residency, and compliance as first-class concerns given our patient/clinical data context

  • Collaborate and demonstrate ownership in a cross-functional team to integrate features smoothly and swiftly into a product

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards

  • Triage incoming alerts for collaborative error monitoring

  • Participate in periodic "SideQuest" hackathon days

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience

  • North American business hours (Eastern time preferred, for better European overlap). Maintain daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

  • Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship

  • A track record of shipping features with measurable user impact — you can tell us what you built, why it mattered, and how you knew it worked

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js ability (GraphQL and tRPC familiarity preferred)

  • Solid React experience building production web applications

  • Experience with databases — should be comfortable with PostgreSQL as well as document databases and KV stores

  • Experience using AWS services in production and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)

  • Proficiency with Git

  • Experience with queue-based systems (BullMQ + Redis) is a bonus

  • Experience working in a regulated or security-sensitive environment (healthcare, fintech, etc.) is a bonus

  • Experience with React Native is a bonus

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO (Canada)

  • Equity share options

  • Support with purchasing work-related books and materials

We take employee wellbeing seriously at Limbic and in addition to the above we offer:

  • Quarterly life days (Enjoy 4 paid days off per year to use whenever you choose - one each quarter - to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters)

  • Access to mental health support

raw.jobDescription:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II (Android) to join our fast-growing mobile team. This role is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally within 1–2 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford or London. We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments.

Within Tripadvisor Experiences we have a fun and friendly environment where the key objective is getting things done. Working closely alongside product managers and designers, our engineers are part of the full process from software design, to code, to test, to deployment and back again. Most of our engineers release code to production every few days and we have a daily release cycle.

What You'll Do

At Tripadvisor Experiences, our Engineers are versatile problem-solvers who thrive on a wide range of technical challenges. This is a Android-focused, full-stack role where you'll primarily work on Android systems, with occasional back-end projects. You don’t need to be an expert with everything — if you're eager to learn, we’ll support you on the job and help you grow your skills. Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Cursor and GraphQL in a modular layout that follows the clean-architecture concept with MVVM.

  • Code! Our engineers focus on doing what they enjoy most and do best, writing code
  • Touch code at every level – while the focus is app development, you’ll also have opportunities to work on backend microservices
  • Collaborate closely with Product and design teams to define feature specifications and develop high quality deliverables for our customers
  • Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering, from design to implementation, development experience, QA and maintenance
  • Work alongside other engineering groups located around the world

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • Experience of developing an Android app and familiarity with mobile web and back-end technologies would be beneficial
  • At least 3 years’ experience of commercial software development, solving different kinds of technical problems
  • Experience with reactive programming in native mobile platforms
  • Willingness and ability to take on new technologies
  • Ability to break down complex problems into simple solutions
  • High quality verbal and written communication skills
  • Sense of ownership and pride in your work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral bonuses. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
